title: California Labor Code section 1194 - Civil action for unpaid minimum wage or overtime
claims: Section 1194(a) provides that, notwithstanding any agreement to work for a lesser wage, any employee receiving less than the legal minimum wage or the legal overtime compensation applicable to the employee is entitled to recover in a civil action the unpaid balance of the full amount of the minimum wage or overtime compensation, including interest, reasonable attorney's fees, and costs of suit.
